messages.subject: conditionalPanel based on fileInput
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am trying to build a page where the user uploads a file and then a model is fit based on that input file. I want some of the UI to depend on the content of the file. So far I have:

ui.R

    fileInput("dataFile", "Data file", multiple=FALSE, accept="text/csv"),    
    uiOutput("speciesList")


server.R

  get.data <- reactive({
    if (is.null(input$dataFile)) {
      # if no data file is uploaded, return NULL
      d <- NULL
    } else {
      # otherwise read the data and return the data.frame
      dataFile <- input$dataFile$datapath
      d <- read.data(dataFile, filetype="csv")
    }
    d
  })
  
  # Get list of species
  output$speciesList <- renderUI({
    d <- get.data()
    sp <- names(d)[-c(1,2)]
    if (!is.null(sp)) selectInput("species", "Species to model", sp)
  })

I would like to get the dependency logic (the fact that the list of species cannot be generate if a file has not been uploaded yet) outside of the server code (all those if conditions) and inside the UI, because I think this is where the belongs (the server should know how to read the file, the UI should tell it when to do so).

So I tried wrapping uiOutput("speciesList") in a conditionalPanel that way:

    conditionalPanel(
      condition="typeof(input.dataFile) != 'undefined'",
      uiOutput("speciesList")
    ),

where typeof != undefined is supposed to test wether input.dataFile is null. Indeed, it is null before anything is uploaded. My problems are:
- I am not sure that javascript condition is valid
- when I inspect the page of my shiny app with the JavaScript console (in Chrome if that matters) the dataFile input value (window.Shiny.shinyapp.$inputValues.dataFile) stays null even after I upload a file.

How should one's UI depend on a file being uploaded?

Thanks in advance,

Jean-Olivier Irisson

messages.subject: Re: conditionalPanel based on fileInput
parts:
Hi, 

 Here is a nice solution. 

server.R:
  get.data <- reactive({
     .........
  })
  output$fileUploaded <- reactive({
    return(!is.null(get.data()))
  })
  outputOptions(output, 'fileUploaded', suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)

ui.R:
   conditionalPanel("output.fileUploaded", 
      ............


Cheers.
